common_structure: lag-ordered n-gram XOR/modulo/offset lookup, projected per-stream keys and shared value, normalized-dot signed-square-root sigmoid gating

history_boundary.qwen_ple: EOS bounds older history; left padding uses EOS
history_boundary.deepseek_engram: DEAD=-1 including current image positions blocks all older lags; EOS itself ordinary; compressed token2 supplies padding

hash_geometry.qwen_ple: checkpoint buffers are authoritative; initializer uses SplitMix64 seed1234+10007*dense-layer-ordinal
hash_geometry.deepseek_engram: PCG64 seeded10007*actual-layer-id1or14; globally unique primes across layers/orders/heads

table_sharding.common: both shard vocabulary rows, not embedding heads
table_sharding.qwen_ple: aligned padded global rows divided evenly across TP
table_sharding.deepseek_engram: ceil(unpadded global rows/TP), last shard padded only to that extent

table_quantization.qwen_ple: BF16, per-table-scale FP8, or group16NVFP4 with global scale

normalization_and_rounding.qwen_ple: zero-centered1+weight, BF16 normalizedQ/K, BF16 gate and U
normalization_and_rounding.deepseek_engram: ordinary affine weights combined FP32, FP32 normalized dot/gate/residual addition thenBF16

stateful_branch.qwen_ple: U + SiLU(depthwise dilated convolution(RMSNorm(U))); convolution history state
stateful_branch.deepseek_engram: direct gated value injection, no convolution or convolution state

reuse_decision: Reuse request mapping, lag loading, prime validation, scratch/compiler utilities, native projections and multi-stream reductions; keep different hash/table/numerical/state contracts explicit rather than route Engram through unchanged PLE.
